proposition: By his own account Ibn Turka had fallen afoul of the traditionist Muḥammad al-Jazarī and the Herat Sufi Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī, whom he calls mafiosos and backbiters, and says al-Jazarī began harassing his students after Ibn Turka gave the Mamluk sultan a poor report of him.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur I (829/1426, to Shahrukh's court) / Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur II (ca. 832-35/1429-32, after exile)
mediation.note: the accused's account of his accusers; not independently confirmed on the pages read
